summary: Phase 7 Business-card / Event-badge Scanner tested end-to-end. All 10 pytest cases pass (auth 401, missing image 400, free-plan 403, admin scan 200 with populated draft, no lead created from /scan/card, confirm empty-name 400, confirm free-plan blocked 403, confirm ok creates lead with source=business_card_scan / tags=['scanned'] / status=NEW / scanned=true, lead appears in /api/crm/leads and /api/admin/leads). Frontend flow verified in Playwright: /admin -> Scan card button -> upload synthetic UAE business-card PNG -> /scan/card returned fully-populated review fields (name 'Feras Askar', title 'Chief Executive Officer', company 'Ariadni Holdings LLC', email 'feras@ariadni.ae', phone normalized to +971501234567, website www.ariadni.ae, city Dubai, country United Arab Emirates, language English) -> selected target card 'Feras Askar (/feras-askar)' -> Save lead -> success toast 'Lead saved to your inbox' and Inbox badge incremented from 9 to 10.

issues: DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description (a11y warning in console, non-blocking)

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to ScanCardDialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: scan_confirm correctly enforces plan gate BEFORE ownership check, so free-plan users get 403 regardless of slug (verified).
scan_confirm returns lead with _id popped and correct workspace_id from the card record — good.
GET /api/admin/leads is not workspace-scoped (noted as pre-existing/out of scope by main agent).
scan_card wraps LLM call in try/except and raises 502 on failure — good defensive handling.

SUPER_ADMIN bypass on ownership check in scan_confirm is intentional; free-user negative test still exercised via plan gate. A dedicated non-admin paid user would be needed to explicitly assert the 403 'Not your card' path in future runs.

seed_data_creation: Created one CRM lead named 'TEST Scanned Lead' on feras-askar via /scan/confirm and one 'Feras Askar' lead via UI. Both remain in DB for follow-up UI verification.
